evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'this would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' — framed time but did not use the phrase 'quote you can depend on' or the full quid pro quo structure, and the wait for yes was minimal/rushed.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Katie), moving day (not stated on call but assumed), route (1781 pi glass drive apartment 123 to 3404 south oak drive, Austin, Texas), size (850 sq ft source, 1000 sq ft destination, 2-bedroom both) — all four covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked: 'What are your biggest concerns or do you have any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' — asked before probing started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer replied 'No, I don't think so. Mainly I'm just trying to move furniture' — no concerns raised, so no follow-up opportunity existed.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — customer raised no concerns, so no reflection was needed or applicable.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covered: property type (apartment, house), floor/stories (first floor apartment, one story house), bedrooms (2 and 2), parking (yes, driveway possible), walking distance (20 feet), access concerns (narrow door but confirmed items fit), no additional rooms. Full logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep stated: 'a typical two bedroom apartment would normally takes two movers that is between two and three and a half to five and a half hours' and then personalized to this move: 'estimated time is between 3 and a half to four and a half hours the estimated cost would be $945' — anchor given and personalized to customer's specific move (10 min distance, first floor to one story, two movers).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed hourly rate ($105/hr per mover, $210 total), truck inclusions (gas, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, and no hidden fees (no credit card fees, no surcharges, no reassembly fees). Full pricing transparency and fee framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. After giving the estimate, customer asked a clarification question about the hourly rate, rep answered, and then customer said 'I think I can give you a call back once I'm ready to finalize this' — no pause or explicit fairness check from the rep.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep stated: 'we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Full coverage of discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep stated: 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the already we that you're paying us. We will provide up to $2,000 per move. That is to repair replace and reimburse for your items.' Mentioned $2,000 and no deductible framing absent; the 'no fine print' language was not explicitly stated. Partial delivery.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent confirmation. No explicit loop closure on the two promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or 'any questions?' — call ended after customer said she would call back, with no final concerns check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' When customer said 'I think I can give you a call back once I'm ready to finalize this,' rep responded 'Sure, I'll go ahead and send you a quote' — the ask was never made. Customer exited the call on her own terms without the rep requesting the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep stated 'There's no deposit required. No recent securing our spot.' — rate lock / no-deposit language present.

top_strength: Comprehensive logistics probing — the rep gathered all seven logistics items (property type, floors, rooms, parking, walking distance, access concerns, and special items) thoroughly and systematically, giving the estimate a solid data foundation.
coaching_note: Did not ask for the business explicitly; when the customer said she'd call back, the rep agreed without ever saying 'Would you like our help with your move?' — this is a hard close requirement and the call ended with the customer controlling the outcome instead of the rep driving the ask.
